messages.content: 2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content:
在2015年，世界国际象棋锦标赛（World Chess Championship）最终以马格努斯·卡尔森(Magnus Carlsen)的胜利告终。  
比赛对手是俄罗斯选手谢尔盖·加里金(Sergey Karjakin)。经过常规时间段双方打成平局后，在决胜阶段卡尔森凭借更高的快速子力赢下了这场冠军争夺战，以总比分 **7½‑6½** 获得第13届世界冠军头衔。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得?" They want who won the 2015 Chess Championship? Likely referring to World Chess Championship 2015 which was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin; Carlsen defended his title successfully.

But maybe they refer to some other tournament like the Chinese national championship or something else. But likely it's world champion. So answer: Magnus Carlsen.

We can also mention he beat Sergey Karjakin with score 7.5-6.5 after tie-breaks. Provide context. Use Chinese as requested earlier. Should respond in Chinese. No tool needed.
